message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine applicable charges from lexicon based on facts.

Facts: Person Yang contracted a pharma company's Chinese medicine department, sold Chinese herbal decoction pieces (中药饮片) without drug production license. He purchased raw materials and packaging, repackaged and labeled, sold. This is illegal production/sale of drug without license. The lexicon includes "生产、销售假药" (production and sale of counterfeit drugs), "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" etc. Also "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". But here it's about drug (中药饮片) which is a drug, not food. There's "生产、销售伪劣产品" (production and sale of inferior/defective products). Also "生产、销售假药" (counterfeit drugs). The facts: He didn't have production license, but he is repackaging and selling. That could be "非法经营" (illegal business). However lexicon includes "非法经营". Also "非法生产、买卖警用装备" etc not relevant.

We need to see which statutory charge matches Chinese law: "非法生产、销售药品" maybe "非法生产、销售假药". But is it counterfeit? He purchased genuine raw materials, but repackaged and labeled possibly misrepresenting origin. Could be "生产、销售伪劣产品" (production and sale of inferior products). Or "生产、销售假药" (counterfeit). The fact says he used packaging and labels of other company, maybe false labeling. That could be "生产、销售假药". Also "非法经营" could apply because he operated without license.

The lexicon includes "非法经营". That is generic for illegal business operations.

Thus likely charges: "生产、销售假药" and "非法经营". Also maybe "生产、销售伪劣产品". Which is more appropriate? The law: If drug is not approved, it's illegal production and sale of "假药" (counterfeit or spurious). The fact: He didn't have production license, but he sold repackaged drug. That is "非法生产、销售药品" which is covered by "生产、销售假药". So include that.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药;非法经营<eoa>

Check lexicon: "生产、销售假药" exactly. "非法经营" exactly.
